name: steamstats
description: SteamStats monorepo - Angular frontend and Fastify backend.

scripts.generate:api: npm run dump:openapi --workspace=backend && npm run generate:api --workspace=frontend
scripts.format:all: npm run format --workspace=backend && npm run format --workspace=frontend
scripts.check:format: npm run format:check --workspace=backend && npm run format:check --workspace=frontend
scripts.check:openapi: npm run generate:api && git diff --exit-code -- frontend/src/app/api/openapi.json frontend/src/app/api/generated/
scripts.check:types: npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.check:build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend -- --configuration production
scripts.check:all: npm run check:audit && npm run check:format && npm run check:types && npm run check:openapi && npm run check:build && npm run check:test
scripts.test:all: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.docker:compose:clear: docker compose down -v && docker compose build && docker compose up
scripts.docker:compose:up: docker compose build && docker compose up
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace=backend && npm run format:check --workspace=frontend
